The '''''Last Legs''''' was a [[Maso-class light cargo hauler|''Maso''-class light cargo hauler]]. [[Navigator/Legends|Navigator]] [[Selbo]] was part of the crew when it was captured by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Harmzuay]]''.
